skill.description: Guides users through creating or updating AI skills with clear metadata, reusable resources, packaging steps, and iteration practices.
skill.summary: Create reusable AI skills with structured instructions, resources, and packaging guidance.

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline path examples, and prose references to helper scripts. The scanned file contains documentation only, with no Ruby backtick execution, system reconnaissance, prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or network behavior. Future bundled helper scripts should be audited separately if they are added.

content.value_statement: Teams often struggle to turn repeatable agent workflows into clear, reusable skill packages. This skill provides a structured process for planning, writing, packaging, and improving AI skills.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md structure and frontmatter metadata.
Guides users to collect concrete examples before writing a skill.
Describes when to use scripts, references, and assets as bundled resources.
Provides an ordered workflow for planning, editing, packaging, and iteration.
Gives examples for PDF, frontend, and database workflow skills.
limitations: It does not include executable helper scripts in the scanned package.
It does not validate or package a skill by itself.
It focuses on Claude skill conventions, which may need changes for other marketplaces.
It still depends on user examples for specialized domains.

use_cases.title: Design a New Agent Skill
use_cases.description: Plan metadata, trigger examples, instructions, and reusable resources for a new skill package.

use_cases.title: Convert Team Knowledge Into Skills
use_cases.description: Turn internal workflows, schemas, policies, or templates into reusable agent guidance.

use_cases.title: Standardize Skill Packaging
use_cases.description: Use a repeatable checklist for skill structure, packaging, validation, and iteration.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a simple repeated workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a skill for [workflow]. Ask for the most important examples, then propose the SKILL.md purpose and metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Bundled Resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for scripts, references, and assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these example tasks: [examples]. Identify which scripts, references, or assets the skill should include and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Refinement of an existing skill that needs clearer triggers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this existing skill description and instructions: [paste text]. Suggest specific edits that improve trigger accuracy and reuse.

prompt_templates.title: Package and Iterate a Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for release readiness and follow-up improvements.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a release checklist for this skill: [summary]. Include validation, packaging, test tasks, and likely iteration points after first use.

output_examples.input: A user wants a skill for recurring PDF editing tasks.
output_examples.output: A focused skill plan with trigger examples, reusable helper resources, and packaging steps for PDF workflows.

output_examples.input: A team has internal database schemas that agents repeatedly rediscover.
output_examples.output: A recommendation to place schema details in reference files and keep SKILL.md focused on workflow guidance.

output_examples.input: An existing skill is broad and activates too often.
output_examples.output: A tighter metadata description, clearer usage examples, and a checklist for removing duplicate instructions.

best_practices: Start with concrete user examples before writing the main instructions.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed reference material into separate files.
Test the skill on real tasks and revise it from observed failures.
anti_patterns: Writing broad metadata that causes the skill to activate for unrelated requests.
Duplicating the same long reference material in SKILL.md and bundled files.
Adding scripts or assets without explaining when the agent should use them.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create AI skills with metadata, instructions, reusable resources, packaging steps, and iteration guidance.

faq.question: Does it create files automatically?
faq.answer: No. The scanned package provides guidance only. It does not include executable helper scripts.

faq.question: Can it update an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for revising metadata, instructions, bundled resources, and packaging readiness.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should references be used?
faq.answer: Use references for schemas, policies, API details, or long domain material that should load only when needed.

faq.question: When should scripts be used?
faq.answer: Use scripts for repeated deterministic tasks, but audit any script before publishing or installing the skill.
